entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for multi-level memory across user, session, and agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official memory engine for Hermes that achieves sub-300ms recall and features a custom vector graph engine with byte-level deduplication. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance across multi-modal sources including Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This AGPL-3.0 context database uses a filesystem management paradigm to unify agent memories and skills via viking:// URIs. It employs tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption by 91% while providing visualized retrieval trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated agent brain that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges to provide synthesis and gap analysis for queried data. It is designed for flexible deployment, supporting both local PGLite and remote server environments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-focused memory system that implements specific retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent persistence. It offers Docker-based deployment alongside dedicated Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: The upstream library for stateful agents that enables peer-centric modeling and background reasoning via FastAPI. It provides both managed and self-hosted options with SDKs for Python and TypeScript.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages memory as a git-like repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system for sub-100ms performance and includes a React-powered TUI.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, SQLite-backed memory system that provides sub-millisecond performance without requiring external services. It includes a TripleStore for temporal knowledge graph management and is compatible with MCP clients and OpenWebUI.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving harness that distills successful agent behaviors into persistent playbooks and local-model training artifacts. It specifically exports CLI-first skills formatted for seamless Hermes agent integration.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine and SQLite message store to ensure no messages are lost. It builds depth-aware summary nodes and provides specialized tools for session recall and expansion.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend wrapper for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes using any OpenAI-compatible or local LLM. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis environments.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer that utilizes an open engram YAML format for plain-text storage on local disks. It supports hierarchical scoping for global and project-specific knowledge across multiple agent platforms like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and memory layer that ensures portable state and secret custody across Hermes, Claude Code, and MCP clients. It features a dedicated dashboard for inspecting and repairing stored memory files.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It uses hybrid retrieval, combining BM25 and vector search, to support Hermes and Claude Code agents.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization plugin that reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× through block reordering and deduplication. It is designed to preserve accuracy while saving up to 36% in token costs for the Hermes ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based memory system that avoids vector databases and embeddings in favor of SQLite with FTS5 search. This five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It features a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps and tracks contradictions for data resolution.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide purpose-built evidence packets for agent queries. It manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs for RAG and vector search. It is an MCP-native server using SQLite-vec and local GGUF models for storage and inference.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory tool that uses semantic search and ranked graph traversal to create bidirectional relationships between notes. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia, including OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This plugin reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: A context layer that resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in 94% fewer prompt tokens. It implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) via stdio or SSE for efficient state resolution.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A daemonless, cross-project memory system that uses a user's Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB for BM25 and semantic retrieval caches.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using an embedded .lbdb graph database that ranks memories by importance (1-10) to surface high-priority data. It supports BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log of all operations. It uses an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider that features semantic search, provenance tracking, and session snapshots. it automatically mirrors memory from native Hermes tools and supports TTL for stored states.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables Hermes agents to handle payments and charge for API usage across multiple blockchain families like EVM and Solana. It integrates financial transactions directly into the agent's operational flow.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and searching. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval quality.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A private local code memory plugin that provides semantic search and grounded Q&A for repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server and supports Hermes via CLI, Telegram, and Desktop interfaces.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider offering 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods. It features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve state.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a software development methodology centered on a subagent-driven-development process. It includes specialized skills for brainstorming and plan writing while emphasizing TDD and YAGNI principles.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. It is compatible with various coding agents and OpenAI-compatible endpoints via a cloud service for flagship models.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped across six major security and AI frameworks. It covers 29 security domains and is compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of draw.io diagrams from natural language descriptions. It supports 11 diagram type presets and can convert Mermaid text into editable files with auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection system. It utilizes a 111-entry word replacement table and 53 pattern categories.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project facilitates collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated deduplication and quality improvement for unified skill libraries across agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library containing 50 expert frameworks and 12 metaskills designed to orchestrate business and code improvement journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code, Codex, and agentskills.io agents.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It includes natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution as an open Agent Skill.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation for detected patterns.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using progressive disclosure of skill metadata. It supports both programmatic and filesystem-based Python skill definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables extraction of YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp. It supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for various agents.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project provides skills that teach agents to write custom analytical prompts via the /prism-scan command. It includes seven pre-built prisms for simulation, optimization, and resilience.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes alongside a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running agents that provides structured memory and a three-level work model. It supports file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task management.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill weaves code and documentation into.lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to help agents remember work. It includes a pipeline for capturing high-value decisions to train replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the agentskills.io specification to enable interaction with the Oracle network and smart contracts. They support CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, CRE, and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This provides standardized prompting guidelines and API integration for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It supports JSON structured prompting and precise hex color specification.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance via file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It includes a Python SkilldockClient, a CLI, and commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, complex multi-step tasks. It features real-time progress tracking and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A local-first workflow language implemented as a single Rust binary under the AGPL-3.0 license. It provides static auditing for secrets and costs, alongside hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill uses a five-layer retrieval system, including semantic embeddings and hard triggers, to find skills. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model reasoning capabilities and tracks token savings in SQLite.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This is a read-only adversarial bug-hunting tool that uses three parallel subagents to analyze code. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec to identify edge cases and integration risks.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure and supports automatic directory registration.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for managing persistent task state.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm to target hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It features a risk-tiered triage system for safe code modifications.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of community skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and integrates with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that covers scales from global to street level. It generates structured reports with core conclusions and integrates user interests via semantic memory.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both binary and source-based installations. It features daily automated updates for all included packages and includes agents from providers such as Google and OpenAI.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It provides an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop agent that requires no admin rights and operates without Docker. It features a GUI, an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines, and an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and offers a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding messaging and web search.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is designed to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, and includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces through a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables production-ready, headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It supports the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading tasks into specialized analyst and researcher roles for research purposes. It includes dedicated agents for risk management and portfolio management to handle complex market analysis workflows.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables task dispatching and multi-agent workflows with integrated cost tracking and quality review gates. It connects to agents via REST API, WebSocket, or MCP servers and supports deployment through Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and mobile-friendly web dashboard for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It ensures agent isolation by utilizing git worktrees and Docker sandboxing during session management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to orchestrated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and automated VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent, this level-based architecture utilizes a task bus for delegation and handoffs between orchestrators and specialists. It features pre-configured skills for VPS provisioning, backup management, and security auditing.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows users to build autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual organization charts to help users manage and delegate tasks within agent teams.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task status and human-in-the-loop verification for task completions. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to allow for direct supervision of Hermes Agent work.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized AI agents through a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator. The agents are divided into specific roles covering research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This project creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two competing AI companies, powered by Hermes Agent and Paperclip, vie for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics for the nine autonomous agents involved.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This skill implements ACP-style delegation to route tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph via an MCP server to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. This tool supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and includes an auto-syncing local index.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool featuring a native Rust TUI for high-performance local monitoring of token usage and costs. It supports integrations for Hermes Agent alongside Claude Code, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect system prompts, tool calls, and streaming responses from Hermes Agent. It allows users to compare adjacent requests for debugging and export portable HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: Offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A community CLI tool for customizing the Hermes terminal UI with themes like cyberpunk or retro DOS. It uses YAML-based configuration to modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents that provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates commerce through SOL and USDC payments and supports identity registration with @handles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in CCC without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time supervision and includes session management and a research desk.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework used to create scoped Hermes Agents with per-folder configurations and skills. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents and supports project-local memories.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A setup featuring preconfigured skills and token-saving CLI workflows that can achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes 40+ skills for research, devops, and finance with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: An automated installation tool that deploys a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services in minutes. It provides three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter for system prompts, tool descriptions, and AI agent configs that operates without API keys or LLM calls. It uses AST and regex to support JSON, YAML, Markdown, and.prompt files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool designed to move OpenClaw configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats. It handles the migration of skills, memory archives, SOUL.md, and MEMORY.md.
entries.observeco/observeco: A self-healing observability tool for monitoring and auto-recovering multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for tool calls and API requests.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It allows for the simultaneous management of Hermes Agent alongside other AI agents and CLI tools in a single application.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that unifies multiple CLI agents into one interface with a zero-configuration built-in engine. It distinguishes itself by automating the creation of office documents, including PowerPoint, Word, and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web-based interface offers full parity with the Hermes CLI experience for both desktop and mobile browsers. It features a three-panel layout for workspace file browsing and utilizes SSH tunneling to provide secure remote access.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to simplify the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: This dashboard focuses on multi-platform connectivity, offering unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It includes a file browser and web terminal while providing usage analytics and profile-scoped file management via local SQLite storage.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for skills, memory, and MCP catalogs.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes specialized native views for Kanban boards, cron jobs, and an embedded terminal for system repair and shell access.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension integrates Hermes Agent directly into the browser context for Chrome and Edge users. It can connect to local runtimes, Hermes Cloud, or remote gateways to provide a full-page web workspace.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime. It is specifically designed to support LaTeX and Markdown rendering for enhanced document visualization.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted dashboard features a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines in real-time. It provides a control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and visualizes tool calls during streaming chat sessions.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS cockpit that tracks per-session quota burn-rates and costs across Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It allows users to inspect transcripts and browse images generated during agent sessions.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This macOS workspace is tailored for Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts, offering one-click automated installation on fresh cloud VMs. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode that utilizes OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this terminal-based dashboard consolidates Hermes chat, sessions, and configuration into a TUI. It includes integrated kanban boards for diagnostics and an extensible Eikon avatar system for lifecycle management.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram, supporting dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It enables background agent spawning with support for up to five concurrent instances and streaming terminal chat.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows application requires no admin rights or Docker to run Hermes Agent locally via LM Studio. It includes a workflow engine for multi-step automation and 100 built-in tools for tasks like TTS and ComfyUI.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This self-hosted assistant features a glassmorphic web interface with real-time log streaming and task tracking. It provides management tools specifically for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A specialized monitoring dashboard that provides read-only inspection of environment variables and configuration. It allows users to track session costs in real-time and inspect the source code of active skills and conversation histories.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace uses isolated profiles to manage separate sessions, memory, and API keys. It features a chat-first design with tool approval cards and an integrated marketplace for discovering new skills and MCP servers.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents for complex tasks. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
